authority_basis: ONE shared, scenario-agnostic cognitive-ecology policy drives the entire cognitive-ecology scenario family. Rules inspect ONLY generic ecology properties (consequence class, lineage/model/runtime/retrieval diversity, concentrations, consensus-strength vote topology, prior-conclusion exposure, fresh-context and independent-design counts, unique epistemic paths, discriminating-contradiction state, challenge budget). No scenario id, no reviewer literals, no expected conclusions, no hidden ground truth. Dispositions are test-only epistemic states, NOT new A-009 lifecycle states. V2 (G3R): correlation risk is generic — concentration on any shared axis triggers friction even at zero prior-conclusion exposure (a blind monoculture is still a monoculture); counter-attractor strong-consensus requires actual dominant-vote concentration, not reviewer count. V3 (G3R2): correlation risk is also detected via max_single_source_lineage_prevalence (a common source shared across otherwise-different bundles is still a shared dependency); UNKNOWN prior-conclusion exposure is neither TRUE nor FALSE (HIGH/MEDIUM independence requires known exposure coverage); UNKNOWN tri-state coverage survives into decision-grade facts.

rules.rationale: raw consensus exists but derives from a single correlated evidence topology; this is not independent confirmation (raw votes are an observation, never multiplied confidence). A common single source shared across otherwise-different bundles is still a correlated topology (G3R2-04).
high-consequence claim lacks sufficient source/model/runtime diversity under the provisional test contract
provisional test-contract independence sufficiency is satisfied; strength of support is NOT a scalar
low-consequence task may use the cheapest admissible path; independence is a constraint, not universal maximization

G3R-04 + G3R2-04: correlation risk is GENERIC — concentration on any shared axis (source bundle, single-source prevalence, model, retrieval) OR prior-conclusion exposure demands a bounded check at high consequence; prior-conclusion exposure is NOT required for correlation to exist. A blind monoculture is still a monoculture, and ten bundles sharing one common source still share a dependency. Friction is triggered by correlation risk, never by disagreement alone.
G3R-04: no shared-axis concentration (including single-source prevalence) and no prior-conclusion exposure -> no epistemic-friction trigger

G3R-03: strong consensus means ACTUAL vote concentration STRICTLY above 0.6 (dominant_vote_ratio > 0.6), not mere reviewer count — a 3/2 split among five reviewers (ratio exactly 0.6) is not strong consensus, and duplicate correlated votes create no independent support. A strong, independently-supported consensus warrants a BOUNDED adversarial check; an honest NO_CHANGE is a success and never manufactures dissent.
